title: Distributed by design: Why Agile Combat Employment needs 1 platform, not a dozen
summary: Learn how Elastic helps ACE's data problem by unifying, normalizing, and correlating heterogeneous data across sites, providing a common operational picture of equipment health, performance, and security.

title: How attackers target banks through trusted logins and tools
summary: Elastic’s November 2026 threat report shows how attackers exploit trusted sign-ins, AI tools, and remote access. Learn how financial institutions can connect security and fraud signals before money moves.

title: Elastic Stack 8.19.25 released
summary:
Version 8.19.25 of the Elastic Stack was released today. We recommend you upgrade to this latest version. We recommend 8.19.25 over the previous versions 8.19.x

For details of the issues that have been fixed and a full list of changes for each product in this version, please refer to the release notes.
